title: Custom CRM Software Cost in India
seoTitle: Custom CRM Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What a custom CRM costs in India compared with Zoho or HubSpot: lead capture, pipeline, WhatsApp, Tally sync. Cost bands, timelines and when custom pays off.
summary: A custom CRM in India typically costs ₹4 lakh to ₹10 lakh for a focused sales pipeline with lead capture and WhatsApp, ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh for a CRM integrated with accounts, operations and a field app, and more for multi-business platforms. Compare this with per-user subscription costs over three to five years.

costBands.includes: Lead capture (website, IndiaMART, WhatsApp), pipeline, follow-ups, quotes, reports
Tally or ERP sync, field sales app, dealer or distributor management, approvals
Several business units, complex pricing, partner portals, analytics

dataPoints.label: Break-even versus SaaS
dataPoints.value: Often reached when 30+ users pay per-seat fees for several years, or when SaaS needs heavy workarounds

dataPoints.label: India-specific features
dataPoints.value: WhatsApp, GST-ready quotes, Tally sync, regional language templates

dataPoints.label: Adoption driver
dataPoints.value: Minimal typing: auto-captured leads and mobile-friendly screens

dataPoints.label: Ownership
dataPoints.value: Code and data owned by you, no per-user fees

body:
## Custom or subscription

Zoho CRM or HubSpot cover most needs quickly. A custom CRM pays off when your sales process is unusual, when it must connect deeply to operations, or when per-user fees become significant. See [custom CRM vs Zoho vs HubSpot](/blog/custom-crm-vs-zoho-vs-hubspot-for-indian-smes).

## What moves the price

- Number of lead sources and assignment rules.
- Quote and pricing complexity.
- Integrations with Tally, ERP and WhatsApp.
- A mobile app for field sales.

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can we start with Zoho and move to custom later?
faqs.a: Yes. Many businesses do; keep data clean so it can be migrated.

faqs.q: How long until the team uses it properly?
faqs.a: Usually a month or two with good training and automatic lead capture.
